title: Stable mean and population variance
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a finite numeric samples list. Return {"mean":mean,"variance":population_variance}, dividing the sum of squared deviations by n, not n-1. Empty samples return {"error":"empty_samples"} and a singleton has zero variance. Use a numerically stable method: tests include small variation around a very large offset, where E[x*x]-E[x]**2 loses accuracy. Do not mutate the list. Results use absolute tolerance 1e-8 with no relative tolerance. Supported inputs have representable means and variances at that absolute tolerance.
